description: (0.5.0, Draft) Verifying one list version (RFC-ACDP-0020 §5.2). Each scenario modifies the golden list body; with no other version at hand the pin contributes list_invalid (reason no_valid_version) and no body evaluated through it is trusted. Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: trust-001 vector 1 (tenant-acme.production, serial 7, issuer = the sig-003 did:key)

expected.behavior: One byte of signature.value flipped: the version fails §5.2 step 1 and is ignored.
An entry's origin changed after signing: content_hash mismatch, version ignored.
The same list re-signed by another did:key: agent_id ≠ pin.issuer (step 2), version ignored.
metadata.list_id 'tenant-acme.staging' under the same issuer: not this pin's series (step 2).
pin.issuer_key_fingerprints names a different key: the verifying key is not in it (step 3), version ignored.
An entry carries an unknown member, or origin 'partner.example.org:8443': schema-invalid (step 4), version ignored.
An entry with registry_did 'did:web:evil.example.com' and origin 'registry.example.com': the whole version is invalid (step 4), not just the entry.
A verified RFC-ACDP-0014 revocation of the issuer key with compromised_since before the list's issue: invalid (step 5).
A list that names another issuer or list as trusted has no such field to do it with, and a consumer MUST NOT add a pin from any list, registry, capabilities document or bundle (§5.1).

With the issuer key's RFC-ACDP-0014 §7 key_revocation class for L: revoked or unplaceable → L is not valid for the pin (the pin gives list_invalid, no_valid_version, when it has no other valid version); not-revoked, pre-compromise or unknown → step 5 passes. Under a local policy that refuses unknown, unknown fails step 5 too.
